cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:

cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Ukončení předmětu je formou zápočtu a zkoušky z tématických okruhů, které byly probírány v průběhu semestru. Pro udělení zápočtu je nutná minimálně 75% účast na cvičeních. Předmět je ukončen zkouškou, která má dvě části. Písemná část spočívá v řešení typických příkladů z obsahu předmětu. Následuje ústní rozprava se zkoušejícím o konkrétním tématický okruhu, který byl v průběhu semestru probírán. Výsledná známka ze zkoušky se skládá ze známek z písemné a ústní části v poměru 60:40.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to introduce students with the basic principles of control, both in open and closed loop. Students will get familiarized with linear and nonlinear systems and their control, continuous and discrete controllers, including two and three-position controllers.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Subjects and methods Cybernetics (allowance 2/2)2.Principles of data collection, presentation and saving. (allowance 2/2)3.Dynamic systems, basic mathematical models. Classification of dynamic systems, static properties of dynamic systems. (allowance 2/2)4.Differential equations, transfer function. Step and impulse function and characteristics. (allowance 2/2)5.Frequency transfer function, amplitude-phase frequency response, logarithmic amplitude and phase frequency response. (allowance 2/2)6.Identification and modeling of systems, use of MATLAB/Simulink tools. (allowance 2/2)7.Automatic control fundamentals, analog and digital controllers. (allowance 2/2)8.Stability of continuous linear systems. (allowance 2/2)9.Control performance, permanent deviations. (allowance 2/2)10.Closed-loop control system synthesis, controller type selection, controller tuning, simulation in MATLAB / Simulink environment. (allowance 2/2)11.Nonlinear systems, basic types of nonlinearities, analysis of nonlinear systems. (allowance 2/2)12.Nonlinear control systems, two- and three-position control. (allowance 2/2)13.Pneumatic and hydraulic systems, amplifiers and regulators. (allowance 2/2)14.Electro-mechanical systems. (allowance 2/2)

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: The course will succesfully ended on the basis of the credit and examination in the topics of the course that were discussed during the semester. The credit will be given on the minimal attendance at the course seminars including at least 75 %. The course is ended on the basis of credit and then the exam which has two parts. Student fulfill the writting exam and discuss with the examiner about specific topics, which were discussed during the semester. Final grade of the test consists of the signs of written and oral in the ratio 60:40.
